# Version 4.150.6 (Unreleased)
> **Ganesh failure handling**

## Highlights

Upcoming 4.150.6 changes improve Ganesh flush status and GPU-buffer upload failure handling.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **GPU failures propagate instead of exposing stale data** — Tracks render-task execution separately from success and checks buffer-upload failures under memory pressure. Affected work can fail rather than draw stale buffer contents; managed flush signatures remain unchanged. ([#5258](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5258), [#5323](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5323))
